text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's this?
This place looks scarier than the last place...
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なぁに？
ここ、
さっきより
怖い場所だよ……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
The ghosts' voices are getting louder.
Are they trying to tell us something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
幽霊たちの声も大きくなってるし、
私たちに何か言おうとしてるの？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Who cares?!
With Little Lyrical all together, there's nothing to fear!
We've got Mister {0} too, so let's keep going!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫！
【リトルリリカル】が全員揃ったら
怖いものなしだよ！
にいちゃんもいるし、
奥まで進んじゃおう！！
